notes.title: Music and More!
notes.content:
Added a radio you can control while driving, you need tunes right?

Also added some performance improvements for PC and Steam Deck

notes.title: Food Mode Difficulty
notes.content: Added difficulty to the food mode. Now easy and medium the damage is only cosmetic. Normal and expert engine damage will affect your speed and you will have to pay to repair the car.

notes.title: Vehicle Damage
notes.content:
We have added vehicle damage to the muscle car in the food delivery mode

notes.title: Adjustments Based on Early Feedback
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Simplified the Graphics settings
[*] Moved difficulty setting to main menu
[*] Esc now will pause the game same a "P" when using Keyboard and Mouse
[*] Added controls info for all input types including SteamDeck
[/list]
